headline: Sonic Pico Park launches soon!
title: Sonic Pico Park Release Date November 12 | Sonic Co-op Chaos | Gaming News
video_script: Sonic is going co-op! Sonic Pico Park, a new Sonic the Hedgehog game inspired by the hit indie puzzle game Pico Park, launches on November twelfth, twenty twenty six. It arrives on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch 2, Switch and PC. Expect puzzle driven co-op action with a Sonic twist. Who would you team up with? Comment below!
description: Sonic Pico Park, a co-op puzzle game inspired by Pico Park, launches November 12, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch and PC.
